title: Where to Travel Near Delhi in Summer: Top 5 Cool Destinations
content:
Looking for a Cool Escape? Here Are the Best Places Near Delhi

Delhi summers can be really exhausting - the heat, traffic, and busy life make everyone want a quick escape. The good news? You don’t have to travel far to find peace, cool weather, and beautiful views.

Here are the top 5 places to visit near Delhi in summer that are perfect for a refreshing break with friends, family, or even solo travel.

1.Manali - Snow, Mountains & Adventure

If you’re dreaming of cool weather and snow-covered peaks, Manali is the perfect destination. Surrounded by the Himalayas, this place offers breathtaking views and a peaceful vibe.

Why visit Manali in summer?

  •  Pleasant weather (10-25°C) 
  • Snow at nearby Rohtang Pass
  • Adventure sports like paragliding & river rafting

Best for: Couples, adventure lovers, and nature seekers

2.Rishikesh - Peace, Yoga & River Rafting

Rishikesh is a mix of spirituality and adventure. Located on the banks of the Ganga River, it’s known for yoga, meditation, and thrilling water sports.

Why visit Rishikesh in summer?

  •  River rafting experience
  •  Calm and spiritual environment
  • Famous spots like Laxman Jhula

Best for: Solo travelers, spiritual seekers, and adventure lovers

3.Mussoorie - The Queen of Hills

Mussoorie is one of the most popular hill stations near Delhi. With cool weather and scenic beauty, it’s perfect for a relaxed vacation.

  • Why visit Mussoorie in summer?
  • Beautiful viewpoints and waterfalls
  •  Walk on Mall Road
  • Visit Kempty Falls

Best for: Families, couples, and weekend trips

4.Nainital - Lakes & Relaxing Views

Nainital is famous for its peaceful lakes and cool climate. It’s a great place if you just want to relax and enjoy nature.

  • Why visit Nainital in summer?
  • Boating in Naini Lake
  • Cable car rides and scenic views
  • Pleasant weath  

Best for: Families and peaceful vacations.

5.Shimla - Colonial Charm & Cool Weather

Shimla is a classic summer destination near Delhi. It offers a mix of history, nature, and a cool climate.

Why visit Shimla in summer?

  • Walk at Mall Road Shimla
  • Visit Kufri for snow & activities
  • Enjoy colonial architecture

Best for: First-time travelers and family trips
